title: Trap Dustshoot TagDuel private hand disruption adapter

cards.name: Trap Dustshoot
cards.officialText: If your opponent has 4 or more cards in their hand: Look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 monster from it to shuffle into the Deck.

behavior.activation: Previously Set Normal Trap, activated in open Main/Battle Phase; selected opposing physical hand must contain at least four cards at activation.
behavior.tagDuelMapping: The activating seat chooses one of the two opposing physical hands; the other opponent's hand is not affected.
behavior.resolution: The hand is privately inspected, one Monster is selected, and the card returns to its physical owner's Main Deck followed by persisted duel-RNG shuffle. Fusion monsters return to the owner's Extra Deck.
behavior.noMonster: If the selected hand contains no Monster at resolution, the inspection resolves without moving a card.
behavior.timing: The four-card condition is checked at activation; a later chain change below four does not retroactively invalidate activation.
behavior.privacy: Only the exact activating physical seat receives the private hand snapshot and selected card; the partner and both opponents receive no private payload.
behavior.persistence: Immutable activation plan and idempotency IDs persist; the private reveal receipt is transient and non-enumerable.
behavior.negation: If negated, the Trap goes to the shared Graveyard and no hand reveal or card return is produced.
behavior.sourceRemoval: Removing the activated Trap from the field after activation does not cancel its already-activated effect.

invariants.handLimitCheck: End Phase; adapter does not discard
